labor.task: Shop fabrication - base cabinets, wall cabinets, reception counter, mailbox unit
Shop fabrication - White Oak window sills and wall caps, custom finish
Field installation - all casework, finish carpentry, leveling, anchoring, seismic bracing (countertops by others)
Submittals, shop drawings, certified payroll, coordination, punch list

scope.title: Manufactured Wood Casework (Sec 12 3200)
scope.text: Furnish and install P-Lam base cabinets (48 LF), wall cabinets (36 LF), reception counter assembly with dual-height ADA surface, 16-slot mailbox unit, all hardware, scribe/filler panels, grommets. Custom Grade AWI, flush overlay, seismic anchoring per ASCE 7.

scope.title: Finish Carpentry (Sec 06 2000)
scope.text: Furnish and install 18 White Oak window sills and wall caps, quarter sawn, vertical grain, 6% max MC, transparent semi-transparent grey-wash finish to match wood doors. Custom Grade AWI, single-source fabricator.

exclusions: P-Lam countertops, backsplash, and Rakks brackets (by countertop subcontractor).
Rough carpentry, blocking, nailers (Sec 06 1053 - by GC or others).
Painting and finishing of non-wood items.
Electrical and data rough-in within casework.
assumptions: Casework quantities based on plan takeoff of tags shown on A3.01, A9.01, A9.10. Field verification required.
White Oak sills/caps count (18) per window count on plans; final count subject to field measure.
Single delivery and installation mobilization assumed. Multiple mobs will require change order.
All work subject to King County prevailing wages. Certified payroll included.
GC provides clear, clean, level working areas and power/water for installation.
